title: Spawn Meadow
summary: The safe-ish landing: tall grass, expedition tents, training dummies.

title: Northern Icefield
summary: A frozen shelf ~175u north where freeze/stun zones occur naturally.

title: Thornveil
summary: Bramble forest east of the meadow; dense sightlines, ranged ambushes.

title: Millcross
summary: Where every road's leftovers end up, and every leftover finds a place to stand.

title: Embervale
summary: A town that grieved its way into a war it didn't start.

title: Norhollow
summary: A town holding its palisade line and its temper by the same nail.

title: Gildmark
summary: The port that sells peace by the pound and war by the crate — same ledger, different columns.

title: Rooktide
summary: The town that came back — proof it can be done, if anyone's still willing to try.

title: Ashvale Front
summary: The dead ground between Embervale and Norhollow where the war is fought in earnest; neither town claims it, and both bury their dead in it.

title: Cindervast
summary: The city that answered a rebellion with a relic, and has been paying for it since.
